newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a near standstill in the Panhandle area Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, USDA said.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 109,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 32,300 formulated and 2,500 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 1-3 1200-1250 lb Holsteins 59.50. Slaughter Heifers Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 65.00.
Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Wk to Date: 109,300 Last Week: 126,700 Year Ago: 97,900
